candidates.sourcePrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a premium, highly refined BRAND IDENTITY PROPOSAL for "xdnote", a calm modern desktop Markdown reading and writing application. This is a DESIGN REVIEW IMAGE only.
One coherent original identity per image. Think meticulous professional identity design: sophisticated optical balance, confident distinctive silhouette, deliberate negative space, excellent small-size readability. Subtlety and restraint, no template look. The symbol must feel designed, not assembled from common UI icons.
Presentation: landscape 3:2, exceptionally crisp vector-like rendering. Warm off-white #F6F6F3 canvas. Large polished app icon on the left, custom lowercase "xdnote" wordmark on the right at the top. Below show the SAME exact symbol in graphite on light and ivory on dark, and a modest aligned row of the same app icon at decreasing sizes labelled 64, 32, 24, 16. Clean generous white space, strict baseline alignment. One small proposal identifier at upper left. No other explanatory paragraphs or slogans.
Palette: graphite #303943, warm ivory #FCFCF8, restrained pale gray for presentation only. Software icon is an optically balanced rounded square containing the symbol, with consistent generous safe area. Brand symbol and wordmark must work in one color. The wordmark is precise humanist/geometric lowercase typography with carefully tuned spacing and polished proportions; spell exactly xdnote. Do not add a dot after the wordmark.
No outlined page containing a pencil; no generic document-with-fold icon; no stacked stationery clipart; no M or N placeholder; no tiny detail that disappears at 16 px; no stock icon collage; no 3D bevel, gloss, mock device, lens flare, drop-shadow effects, marketing copy, fake trademark, registration sign or watermark.
Every sample must be the SAME identity, not variants or alternative logos within one board.
Proposal identifier: "A · 折光".
Design direction: an ORIGINAL abstract page-turn symbol made of two broad sculpted planes and one exceptionally elegant folded transition. Solid fills, not outline drawing. An asymmetric but optically balanced compact silhouette: a calm vertical paper plane melts into a precise diagonal fold, and one clean negative-space slit suggests the turning page. A small hint of curvature gives warmth; the diagonal fold supplies precision. It must read as a memorable abstract brand glyph at first, with the page idea discovered second. No literal sheet outline and no pen. Make the app icon feel exceptionally finished through proportion alone. The final form should be simple enough to reproduce as 2 or 3 vector paths.
candidates.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is the edit target: the chosen xdnote A · 折光 logo review board. Edit it with the smallest possible change. Preserve the exact logo silhouette, sharp diagonal negative-space slit, proportions, spacing, background, wordmark, all text, and the layout. The symbol consists of two separate solid planes: the tall upper-left plane and the lower-right plane. Make their brightness visibly but elegantly different, using two related neutral graphite shades: retain the tall upper-left plane in deep graphite and make the lower-right plane a moderately lighter graphite gray. Repeat the SAME two-tone treatment consistently in the large symbol, the light-background version and every small-size light-background icon. On the dark-background reverse version, use a light ivory tall upper-left plane and a moderately darker soft gray lower-right plane, maintaining good legibility. Keep the same flat solid fills without gradient, texture, extra borders or shadows. Do not change the shapes, the clean curved slit, the word 'xdnote', or redesign anything. This is a presentation image for review, not a final asset.
candidates.referenceNote: The prior A single-tone image was the edit input; the project stores only the latest A board.

Proposal identifier: "B · 书脊".
Design direction: an ORIGINAL elegant reading-space symbol based on an open book's quiet central spine. Two broad curved geometric strokes, slightly offset, frame a beautifully proportioned vertical negative-space gap. A gentle asymmetric terminal evokes a bookmark without drawing a literal bookmark or book. Friendly, architectural, calm and premium. Solid, robust forms with rounded inner corners and crisp restrained terminals. The silhouette must be distinctive and compact, not a generic book icon, not headphones, not a heart, not an enclosing rounded rectangle, and not a letter M. Give the wordmark especially careful optical kerning and a humanistic quiet character.

Proposal identifier: "C · 连字".
Design direction: an ORIGINAL expertly drawn compact lowercase "xd" ligature as a single brand glyph. The diagonal rhythm of x flows into the rounded counter of d using one shared structural stroke and an elegant controlled negative-space cut. The result must be effortlessly readable as a distinctive custom monogram, not two typed letters placed together. Harmonize straight and curved geometry, with a quiet editorial character. No ribbons, no infinity sign, no generic code brackets, no surrounding page or pen. The same custom letter details echo subtly in the full lowercase xdnote wordmark. Refined, confident, memorable, and robust at small scale.
